info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Prioritys-v3-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Prioritization API enables users to retrieve a list of defined priorities for support tickets. This API serves as a central resource for managing ticket priorities, ensuring efficient handling of customer inquiries based on urgency. Support teams and customer service applications can leverage this API to provide context-sensitive prioritization for issue resolution. Use cases include integrating priority options into ticketing systems or enhancing support workflows to improve response times.

get.description: Fetches the available priority levels for tickets, helping users assign appropriate importance to their requests.

requestBody.description: This request retrieves the priority level of tickets. The body must contain the necessary parameters to filter or specify the ticket priorities being requested.

201.description: The priority ticket has been successfully created.
